question: How can I ensure that my prenatal care is confidential, and what are my rights regarding privacy and confidentiality as a pregnant adolescent?
answer: Confidentiality Rights: HIPAA Laws: In the United States, the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) protects your medical information. Healthcare providers must keep your health information private. Minor Consent Laws: Many states have laws allowing minors to consent to prenatal care without parental involvement. Confidentiality Policies: Healthcare providers have confidentiality policies in place. They cannot share your medical information without your permission, except in specific circumstances (such as reporting child abuse). Ask About Policies: When you visit a healthcare provider, ask about their confidentiality policies. They can explain how they protect your privacy. Access to Records: You have the right to access your medical records. If you're concerned about privacy, ask your provider how you can access your records securely. Exceptions: In some cases, healthcare providers may need to involve parents or guardians if they believe your health or safety is at risk. This could include situations involving abuse or neglect. Ensuring Confidentiality: Open Communication: Talk openly with your healthcare provider about your concerns regarding privacy. They can address your questions and explain how they maintain confidentiality. Designated Contact: If you prefer, you can designate a specific person (other than a parent) as your primary contact for medical information. Understanding Policies: Understand your healthcare provider's policies regarding confidentiality, including how they handle electronic medical records and communication. Legal Protections: Know your rights under HIPAA and state laws. Healthcare providers are legally bound to protect your privacy. Seek Support: If you have questions about your rights or feel your privacy has been violated, seek support from a trusted adult, counselor, or advocacy organization. They can provide guidance on next steps.
attribution: HASH Consortium and the Zindi Africa Multilingual Health QA Challenge

question: Sɛn na bra (afikyireko) kwan no ka nipa adwene ne n’aniagyeɛ, n’ahoɔden, ne n’apɔmuden nyinaa?
answer: Bra kwan no afa horow (Menstrual Cycle Phases): Bra (afikyireko): Eyi ne bere a awodeɛ (uterus) no nwoma a ɛhyɛ mu no firi aseɛ pae na ɛba sɛ mogya; eyi kɔ so bɛyɛ nnafua mmiɛnsa kɔsi nson. Nkesua siesie bereɛ (Follicular phase): Eyi ne berɛ a nkesua (egg) no firi aseɛ nyini wɔ ababaawa-ba (ovary) no mu, na nipadua mu nnuru a yɛfrɛ no 'estrogen' no firi aseɛ kɔ soro. Nkesua pue bere (Ovulation): Eyi ne bere a nkesua (egg) no pue firi ababaawa-ba (ovary) no mu; eyi sisi bɛyɛ bra kwan no mfinimfini hɔ. Awodeɛ siesie bere (Luteal phase): Eyi ne bere a awodeɛ (uterus) no nwoma a ɛhyɛ mu no firi aseɛ yɛ mmerɛmmerɛ na ɛyɛ kɛseɛ, na nipadua mu nnuru a yɛfrɛ no 'progesterone' no firi aseɛ kɔ soro. Awodeɛ siesie bere (Luteal phase): Eyi ne bere a awodeɛ (uterus) no nwoma a ɛhyɛ mu no firi aseɛ yɛ mmerɛmmerɛ na ɛyɛ kɛseɛ, na nipadua mu nnuru a yɛfrɛ no 'progesterone' no firi aseɛ kɔ soro:  Eyi ne bere a nkaeɛ a ɛsakyera basabasa, abofufu, ne mmerɛyɛ ba ansa na bra (afikyireko) no afiri aseɛ.  Brayɛ mu Akisikuru: Ɛyaw wɔ yafunu ase ne akyi. Nsakrae a Ɛba Ahoɔden Mu: Ebia ebinom bɛte ɔbrɛ anaa ɔbrɛ kɛse nka berɛ a wɔrekɔ brayɛ mu.

question: Dɛn ne nhwɛso ahorow bi a ɛfa nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔadi nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ ASRH nnwuma mu, te sɛ nyinsɛn ano a wobenya, nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a edi mũ, anaa awoɔ apomode]n ho nhyehyɛe ho dwuma yie?
answer: Nhwɛsoɔ bi a ɛfa nnwuma a mmabun di anim a wɔadi nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ ASRH dwumadie mu ho dwuma yie ne: atipɛnfoɔ nkyerɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a mmabun di anim a ɛma nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri na ɛhyɛ nneyɛeɛ pa ho nkuran wɔ atipɛnfoɔ mu. question: Nneɛma bi wɔ hɔ a ɛbɛboa me ma mate hokwan ahorow a mewɔ wɔ awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ gyinaesi ahorow a wɔde siw nyinsɛn ano mu ase?
answer: Bere a ɔman no mu ahwehwɛde biara nni hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ awofo pene so wɔ Ghana no, eyi mu a wobɛfa so no betumi ayɛ basaa. Nneɛma a ɛbɛboa wo ma woate wo hokwan ahorow ase ni: wo ne wo mmabun adamfofa akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo nkasa wɔ ehalyh adwumayɛbea a ɛbɛn wo Ghana Legal Aid Commission: Wɔde mmara ho afotu ma kwa ma Ghanafo, a mmofra nkumaa ka ho, wɔ tebea horow bi mu. Wubetumi ahu wɔn nkitahodi ho nsɛm ne wɔn a wɔfata ho nhyehyɛe wɔ wɔn wɛbsaet (https://www.lac.gov.gh/).

question: Ɔkwan bɛn so na awofo ne abusuafo betumi akyerɛkyerɛ mmabun a wɔadi dɛm nna mu awo akwahosan "sexual reproductive health" ho ade na wɔaboa wɔn mma?
answer: Nneɛma a Wotumi de Ho To So "Reliable Sources": Hwehwɛ nsɛm fi ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din te sɛ Wiase Nyinaa Akwahosan Ahyehyɛde "World Health Organization" (https://www.who.int/health-topics/sexual-health) anaa akuw a wɔhwɛ mmubuafo hokwan ahorow hɔ. Di wo ba no ahoɔden ne ne ankorankoro su ho afahyɛ.

question: Mɛyɛ dɛn ahwɛ ahu sɛ ɔhwɛ a menya wɔ me nyinsɛn berɛ mu  no yɛ kokoamsɛm, na hokwan bɛn na mewɔ wɔ asumasɛm ne kokoamsɛm ho sɛ ɔbabun a onyinsɛn?
answer: Confidentiality Rights: HIPAA Laws: Sɛ wokɔ United States a, mmara bi yɛfrɛ no Health Insurance Portability and Acountability Act (HIPAA) bɔ w'apɔwmuden nsɛm ho ban. Etwa sɛ ayaresafoɔ bɔ wo kokoam nsɛm ho ban. Minor Laws: Amanaman bebree wɔ mmara ɛma mmabun kwan ma wonnya ɔhwɛ berɛ a wɔnyem, na w'awofoɔ mpo nntumi nnsi wɔn kwan.Confidentiality Policies so hwɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔhwɛ wo nntumi fa wo nsɛm nnto abɔnten gye asɛm pɔtee bi as te sɛ 'Child abuse', mmofra yɛyɛ wɔn basabasa. Sɛ wokɔ nsrahwɛ wɔ ayaresabea, bisa wɔn kokoam nsɛm ho mmara wode di dwuma. Wobetumi akyerɛkyerɛ wo mu. Wo bisa wo records so a wɔde bɛma wo mpo wɔ kokoam. Hyɛ ne nsew sɛ ɛtɔ dabi a, ayaresafoɔ behia w'awofoɔ sɛ wohu sɛ wo nkwa ho aba asɛm a. Te sɛ ebia wɔyɛ wo basabasa anaa wɔnnhwɛ wo so yie.Wopɛ wobetumi ama ɔmo ehu obia sɛ biribi to wo a, wotumi frɛ no. Kae sɛɔ HIPAA mmara no bɔ wo ban, nti etwa sɛ wɔdi so pɛpɛɛpɛ. Sɛ wonnte biribi ase a, bisa wɔn. Wɔbɛkyerɛ wo kwan a fa.

Fa n’awiei a wɔato mu no kura kɔndɔm no mu na pia mu nkaa no wɔ wo nsateaa kɛse ne wo nsateaa ketewa ntam. Fa kɔndɔm no hyɛ ɔbea no awotwaa no mu, hwɛ hu sɛ emu mprɛte no te awotwaa mu na akyi nkaa no bɛkɔ so atra abɔnten wɔ awotwaa no atifi. Hwɛ sɛ kɔndɔm no nkyinkyim na ɛkata awotwaa no ne akyi awotwaa no fã bi so. Sɛ wo ne obi da wie a, kyinkyim akyi nkaa no ma ɛkata kɔndɔm no so na twe no brɛoo fi ɔbea no awotwaa no mu. Tow kɔndɔm a wode adi dwuma no gu nwura mu. Mfa nsu nkɔ tiafi mu. Nnuru a Wɔde Siw Awo ano: Nom aduru biako bere koro mu da biara, sɛ ɛbɛyɛ yiye a, fa aduan anaa nsu ka ho na aboa ma woatwe wo ho. Akwansideɛ a mmabun betumi ahyia bere a wɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔne wɔn awofo bɛkasa afa atipɛnfo nhyɛso ne nna mu nsɛm ho no bi ne: Atemmu ho suro; mmabun betumi ahaw wɔn ho wɔ sɛnea wɔn awofo bɛyɛ wɔn ade wɔ wɔn nsɛmmisa anaa nsɛm a ɛhaw wɔn ho, suro a wosuro sɛ wɔbɛkasa atia wɔn anaa sɛ wɔrempene so. Aniwu: Nsɛm a ɛfa nna ne awo mu nsɛm ho a wɔbɛbɔ ho nkɔmmɔ no betumi ayɛ nea ɛnyɛ dɛ anaa sɛ ɛyɛ fɛre ma mmabun ne awofo nyinaa, na ɛma wɔn mpɛ sɛ wɔbɛka asɛm no ho asɛm. Nkitahodi ho nimdeɛ a wonni: Ebia mmabun binom bɛpere sɛ wɔbɛka wɔn nsusuii ne wɔn atenka horow ho asɛm yiye, na ama ayɛ den sɛ wɔne wɔn awofo befi nkɔmmɔbɔ ase anaasɛ wɔbɛkɔ so abɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa nsɛm a ɛho hia ho Akwan a wɔbɛfa so adi akwanside ahorow yi so no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛpaw bere ne beae a ɛfata a wɔbɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛbɔ kokoam nsɛm na wɔatew nneɛma a ɛtwetwe adwene so na ama wɔanya tebea a ahotɔ ne ahobammɔ wom. Sɛ wode anammɔn nketenkete te sɛ asɛmmisa tiawa bi a wubefi ase anaa

question: So ahyehyɛde ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛtew animtiaabu so a metumi aboa? (akuw a wɔkamfo kyerɛ, nnwuma a mmabun di anim) .
answer: Ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ animtiaabuo a wɔbɛtew so a ebia wobɛtumi aboa (hwɛ wɔn mfeɛ a wɔhwehwɛ na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu ni): Ghana Healthn Service, Mariestopes Ghana Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG): Ebia wɔwɔ mmabun nhyehyɛeɛ anaa nneɛma a wɔde bɛdi nkitaho ne afoforɔ a wɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ animtiaabuo a wɔbɛtew so. question: Fa nneɛma ma nna mu akwaahosan ho telefon anaa ayaresabea ahorow a mmabun betumi ayɛ nhwehwɛmu na wɔasa wɔn yare wɔ nna mu yareɛ (STI ) ho wɔ kokoam.
answer: Nneɛma bi a wɔde bɛyɛ kokoam nna mu yareɛ  (STI ) nhwehwɛmu ne ayaresa a wɔde ma mmabun wɔ Ghana ni: Akuo a wfrɛ wɔ broɔfo  kasa mu sɛ Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana (PPAG ahomatorɔfo): 0244312151 (Frɛ Memeneda-Fida, anɔpa 8-5pm) Ghana AIDS Commission Helpline: 0800123456 (Toll-Free) GHS-YMK mobile app Public Health facilities /Akwahosan adwumayɛbea a ɛyɛ mmabun ne Mmabun adamfofa Ministry of Health : https://www.moh.gov.gh/ (Saa abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn yi wɔ akwaahosan ho adwumayɛbea ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ no sɛnea ɔmantam biara te) Kae sɛ, sɛ wobɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu na woasa  nna mu yarewa (STIs) a, ɛyɛ sɛnkyerɛnne a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wode wo nna mu akwahosan ho asodi to wo ho so. Mma ntwentwɛn wo nan ase sɛ wobɛkɔ akwahosan ho ɔyaresafo a wogye no di anaa saa nneɛma yi nkyɛn akɔhwehwɛ kokoam ne adwumayɛfo mmoa. Ɛnyɛ wo nko ara!
